logp.method_description: The traditional shake-flask method was used to obtain distribution coefficients of the ligands as well as of the complexes in n-octanol/buffered aqueous solution (20 mM phosphate, pH = 7.40 or 10 mM MES, pH 5.50) at different chloride ion concentrations (4, 24 and 100 mM) using UV-vis spectrophotometry (Agilent Cary 8454 diode array spectrophotometer, Santa Clara, CA, USA) for the analysis. The measurement and data evaluation were performed as described in our former work [12,13].
